title: P1-04 — Host metrics 500-ms parity over identity-bound SSH
objective: Deliver historical host CPU/RAM/GPU/VRAM/temperature metrics at a 500-ms target using a Sol-reviewed, owner-approved bounded push channel; no guest-initiated host API or copied Compose sidecar topology. Operating policy: docs/workflows/phase1-continuous-execution.md; this is M3 after M1/M2. Reuse the current schema/collector; request owner NVIDIA collection/timing evidence before choosing the GPU sampling method. Supported NVIDIA utilization and VRAM remain required; no criteria are relaxed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Before implementing any new host-to-guest metrics transport, submit the exact proposed design for Sol's combined security/implementation assessment and obtain explicit owner approval of the bounded push interface.

Host hardware snapshot target cadence is 500 ms, matching the established implementation. Collector and transport do not overlap, block the TUI, accumulate queues, or launch an unbounded number of processes. Measure collection/push time; on deadline/overrun skip or mark unavailable rather than fabricate or queue samples.

Use the per-parent host-key-verified SSH route to push a fixed versioned schema to a fixed guest receiver, with a separate per-run metrics key enforced server-side to permit only the receiver (no PTY, forwarding, startup hooks, or arbitrary commands). If retaining the broader owner key is proposed, stop for explicit owner acceptance of that residual authority. No guest-initiated host request, new listener/port, proxy permission, direct host filesystem/device mount, Docker socket, arbitrary command interface, or PID-file authority.

Bound snapshot size (16 KiB proposed starting maximum), exact schema keys, values, arrays, strings, collector execution and transport deadlines. Include opaque run ID, strictly increasing per-run sequence, UTC diagnostic sample timestamp, defined sampling duration, and explicit unavailable/error states. Receiver uses guest-monotonic receipt time for freshness; reject wrong-run, duplicate/decreasing sequence, and stale/replayed frames. Set a measured fixed stale threshold (Sol recommends 1.5 seconds); do not compare host and guest monotonic clocks.

Guest receiver verifies a dedicated tmpfs-backed private directory, validates type/range/size and run/sequence, and atomically replaces a fixed snapshot using directory-relative no-follow/exclusive file operations. Read-only metrics tool/TUI updates at the 500-ms target without blocking OpenCode; stale/unavailable is explicit and valid subsequent samples recover automatically.

Reuse safe portions of the historical 500-ms collectors, formatter, and TUI presentation; do not import their Compose HTTP server/network topology or import-time sampler side effects. Keep a portable collector interface; Linux/KVM is the supported Phase 1 runtime, vendor collectors are optional/provenance-checked, and missing hardware is reported unavailable.

Tests establish 500-ms cadence and non-overlap under normal load, collector deadline/overrun behavior, schema/size/provenance validation, unavailable/stale/recovery rendering, atomic replacement, symlink refusal, SSH timeout/overflow, no added network listener/egress, and no host data outside the fixed metrics schema.

needed: Sol design review and owner authorization before code.
Schema bounds, unavailable/stale data, timestamps, atomic replacement, symlink refusal, timeout, overflow, provenance and no-listener/no-new-egress negatives.
Owner hands-on metrics accuracy and stale/unavailable display on the protected interactive guest.
Sol combined review of exact metrics design packet; owner approval before transport implementation.
Measure collector and SSH push latency/resource overhead against 500-ms cadence; guarantee no overlap/unbounded queue.
Schema, payload bounds, timestamps/freshness, unavailable/stale/recovery, atomic replace, provenance, symlink, timeout/overflow, and no-listener/no-egress negatives.
Owner hands-on 500-ms cadence/accuracy and stale/unavailable checks on final protected interactive VM.

Sol combined design assessment completed; resolve blocking conditions and obtain owner approval of identity scope, deadlines/schema/staleness, optional GPU policy and tmpfs ownership before transport implementation.
Measure collector and SSH delivery/ACK budget below 500 ms; one outstanding frame, absolute monotonic schedule, no overlap/catch-up/replay/queue, bounded retries, exact-process cleanup.
Schema bounds, wrong-run/sequence/replay, freshness, timestamps, optional-field unavailable/error, provenance and restart semantics.
Atomic tmpfs replacement, symlink/path substitution, unsafe permissions/non-tmpfs, interrupted writes and concurrent receiver negatives.
Stalled/hung collection or helper, excess output, blocked write/ACK, SSH disconnect/auth/host-key failure, and bounded recovery/no process leak.
Owner hands-on cadence/accuracy and stale/unavailable display on final protected interactive guest.
created: MOCK/PURE: commits 01bca0f/ac07a0b add lib/vm/parent-metrics.py fixed v1 contract and compact UTF-8 encoder: exact keys, <=16KiB, opaque per-run hex ID, increasing positive sequence field, UTC-ms diagnostic timestamp, bounded duration, strict CPU/RAM/GPU/temperature values, allowlisted explicit unavailable/error states. Tests 9/9 cover malformed fields, bounds, huge integers, control/bidi text, memory rounding consistency, absent hardware, maximum current payload (>12KiB but <=16KiB), encoding cap and timestamps. No hardware collector, cadence/scheduler, SSH, receiver, VM, or owner acceptance yet; criteria remain pending.

SCHEDULER (MOCK): commits 43ad7be/14d78bf add fixed synchronous absolute 500-ms slot scheduler; uses monotonic nanoseconds, passes slot/deadline to one callback, serializes collection+delivery, skips expired slots without catch-up/queue. Fake-clock tests verify 100-ms cadence spacing, 800-ms overrun skips, exact-on-time and nonzero-origin exact-later slot preservation, stop handling, one callback in flight and invalid clock. Metrics contract suite 14/14. This does not yet enforce callback deadlines or implement collector, SSH ACK, receiver freshness, VM wiring, or hardware measurement.

Sol Medium scheduler review of 43ad7be found exact-deadline slot arithmetic issues. Follow-up 14d78bf uses integer monotonic-nanosecond cadence, preserves exact later slots even at nonzero origins, and checks stop before skipped-slot accounting. Focused delta review confirmed boundary behavior; metrics tests 14/14 passed. No collector, transport, receiver, hardware measurement, or acceptance claim.

MOCK/PURE: commits 2bde5e8/0663d6b add side-effect-free injectable parsing/collection (no gather.py import, hardware probe, SSH, or VM). Reuses historical CPU/load, meminfo, GPU CSV and thermal-value shapes; bounds parser input/arrays, invokes fixed adapters synchronously with a monotonic deadline, discards late adapter/parser results and gives timeout precedence, skips later adapters after expiry, validates the final fixed snapshot, and refuses duration >5s. Tests/vm-parent-metrics.test.py: 23/23, including fixture values, malformed/oversized sources, absent hardware, timeout/exact deadline/parse overrun, and duration bounds. Adapter calls must cooperatively enforce deadlines; this block does not prove hardware behavior or a hard preemption guarantee.

Linux proc adapter slice (commits ddb662f/c1033f0): lazy read-only adapters read only fixed cpuinfo/loadavg/meminfo paths via bounded O_NOFOLLOW regular-file reader; injected GPU/temperature adapters remain optional and no device probe occurs. Tests cover fixture extraction, laziness, no-follow/nonregular/oversized rejection, and stopping between proc reads at deadline. Sol review found and follow-up closed missing between-I/O deadline checks. Metrics suite 26/26; no real /proc, hardware, GPU, temperature, SSH, VM, or performance acceptance performed.
cases: Design-only Sol assessment: PASS WITH CONCERNS. Owner approved a separate per-run receiver-restricted metrics SSH key, absolute 500-ms schedule, one-frame ACK/backpressure, fixed 1.5-s stale threshold and private tmpfs-only snapshots. GPU unavailable is permitted only where hardware lacks support/during implementation; supported NVIDIA GPU utilisation and VRAM remain Phase 1 acceptance requirements. This is not implementation review or acceptance; no metrics transport exists yet.

comments.body: Workflow reminder for #54–#57: record durable discussion, review findings, and owner decisions as append-only comments with the ticket-engine CLI (--comment), not as prose in tests.created. Keep test ledgers limited to concise test evidence and actionable test gaps.

comments.author: cli
comments.body: Sol Medium independent review of schema commit 01bca0f returned SIMPLIFY/needs correction: oversized JSON ints could raise OverflowError, hardware labels admitted terminal/bidi controls, payload test did not exercise realistic bounds, and RAM consistency needed clarification. Follow-up ac07a0b addresses these: exact integer bounds before conversion; reject Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp; validate rounded RAM sum within 0.16GB and document raw-value percentage semantics; exercise max-field snapshot (>12KiB, <=16KiB) plus encoder guard. Focused Sol delta: findings addressed, no blocker. Tests 9/9. Host collector/transport/receiver remain unimplemented; no acceptance criteria passed.
